the in situ XAS results show that the electronic structure of the cathode material is modified during lithiation/dilithiation and the degree of modification is dependent on the composition of the material, the extent of lithiation/delilithiation and also the cycling history of the material.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the local structure of the transition metal sites in LiNiO 2, LiNi 0.8 Mn 0.2 O 2, LiMn 1.5 Ni 0.5 O 4, and LiMn 2 O 4 changes significantly during the lithiation/delition process, and that the changes in the electronic structure are correlated with the changes in the local structure of transition metal site.
the electronic structure of these cathodes is not as simple as one would expect.
the electronic and atomic structures of the cathode material are intimately linked and must be considered together in order to fully understand the electrochemical properties of the material.
